    e€. ffeating and Ventilating Cabinet Assembly. This assembly is located at the approximate

center of the right (curbside) wall of the battery control trailer. It contains a personnel heater and
ventilating system, storage batteries, and a battery charger. The batteries are used to power the
switchboard, the alert siren, and the personnel heater, and provide emergency power for lighting and
personnel ventilation. Figure 16 and table XII show the controls and indicators for the heating and

49. Starting Fluid                                                                       HOSE BRACKET

   The starting fluid will be received in individual
containers, each of which contains sufficient start-
ing fluid for servicing one missile. There are two
kinds of starting fluid—unsummetrical dimethyl
hydrazine (UDMH)=and a mixture of aniline and

       irvl alcohol. The aniline-alcohol mixture is
inserted into the missile with the starting fluid
svringe. The syringe will hold the exact amount
of starting fluid for one missile. The hydrazine
mixture will be inserted into the missile by con-
necting the shipping container to the starting fluid
filler plug in the missile, raising the bottle above
the missile, and allowing the fluid to flow into the
missile by gravity.

                                                          140. Developing

                                                              To start the developing process, close the doors
                                                          on the upper part of the machine, and turn the
                                                          motor-on switch (S2) to ON. After all of the
                                                          paper has been developed, turn switches $1 and S2
                                                          to OFF. Open the machine and remove the take-
                                                          up spool from its spindle. Pull the center from
                                                          the spool. Reinsert the spool into the machine.
                                                          When the latter part of the roll is being developed,
                                                          the paper may become loose as it leaves tank No. 4.
                                                          This can result in the paper zoing over the idler
                                                          roller before the drying drum and possibly tearing
                                                          the paper. To prevent this, use a smooth rod or
                                                          stick to guide the paper onto the drving drum.
